unresolved.description: The intent states the guard should trigger ONLY when one side receives without sending, i.e. a necessary-condition (one_side_receives_without_sending is required for zero_cost_guard_triggered). The required_effect template expresses only sufficiency (condition implies effect), so the 'only when' direction cannot be encoded faithfully; the closest supported form is retained for audit.

The report does not quote the exact zero-cost check expression or its operands, so the relation between disjoint-bit amounts and guard triggering is represented by grounded Boolean observables rather than a numeric expression.

limitations: The 'only when' necessary-condition polarity of the intent is not expressible in the fixed required_effect template; the generated I encodes the sufficiency direction and is flagged for audit.
Unexplained failures are encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric or structural definition of the failure.
